A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose to learn an orthogonal projection matrix to project an input feature vector onto a subspace for each capsule, and that each projection matrix is updated to be orthogonal to all other projection matrices.

we propose a new capsule net architecture, CapProNet, which can be easily plugged into the existing deep networks and significantly improve their performance by projecting input features onto low-dimensional subspaces.
we propose an efficient capsule projection method to learn the orthogonal projections onto the capsule subspaces and demonstrate that it is effective in improving the performance of the capsule nets.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed capsule projection is more effective than the conventional weight normalization to learn capsule representations, which can be easily incorporated into the state-of-the art deep networks.
the orthogonal capsule projection can effectively improve the performance of capsule nets and the conventional weight normalization can be viewed as the capsule projection onto a 1D line.
the capsule projection is a powerful tool for learning capsule subspaces to improve the performance of capsule nets, which is orthogonal to the design of capsule subspaces.
